lines.say: The bench press. Here's what it really works.
Your chest muscles push the bar up and pull your arms together.
The front of your shoulders helps.
And your triceps straighten your elbows at the top.
Grip changes it. A closer grip puts more work on the triceps.
Pinch your shoulder blades together, and plant your feet.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, then press.
And always use a spotter or safety bars when you go heavy.
